name: Ain Mutaqorrobin
tagline: I build web and mobile apps end to end: the screens people use, the APIs behind them, and the pipelines that ship them.
heroSummary: Software engineer with around three years of experience building web and mobile products, currently leading a cross-platform mobile team shipping React Native (Expo) apps to Google Play and the App Store. Hands-on production experience with React Native, Next.js, TypeScript, NestJS, and PostgreSQL, along with AWS infrastructure (EC2, RDS, S3, ALB, IAM) managed with Terraform and release automation through EAS CI/CD.
availability: Open to freelance projects, software roles, and technical collaborations.
about: I am a software engineer based in Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia, with around three years of experience building and maintaining applications across web and mobile platforms.
My work covers frontend development, backend services, debugging, maintenance, and shipping features that are practical for real users and teams.
Lately I have been going deeper into microservices and DevOps, especially Docker and Kubernetes, to strengthen how I design, package, and deploy production systems.

principles.title: Practical shipping
principles.body: I prefer useful software over impressive complexity, and I care about whether teams can keep delivering after launch.

principles.title: Cross-stack ownership
principles.body: Frontend, backend, deployment, and debugging all matter when product quality depends on the full system.

principles.title: Calm engineering
principles.body: Readable structure, documented decisions, and repeatable workflows beat heroics when deadlines start to tighten.

workExperience.summary: Leading mobile, owning backend services and the AWS footprint they run on.
highlights: Lead the mobile development team building cross-platform Android and iOS applications with React Native and Expo.
Built a CI/CD pipeline on EAS (Expo Application Services) that automates builds and submission to the Google Play Store and Apple App Store.
Integrated third-party identity services, including Singpass (MyInfo API) for government-verified user data and Tencent Cloud eKYC for identity verification.
Manage production infrastructure on AWS (EC2, RDS, S3, ALB, IAM), provisioned and maintained with Terraform.
Develop backend services with NestJS and PostgreSQL, including scheduled cron jobs, and maintain containerized environments for repeatable deployments.

workExperience.summary: Built web applications using Next.js and TypeScript in a product-focused team.
highlights: Built and maintained modern web applications using Next.js and TypeScript.
Connected back-end and front-end systems through RESTful APIs using Axios.
Tested and documented APIs with Swagger and Postman to ensure correct behaviour and smooth deployments.

workExperience.summary: Enterprise web applications using Angular and TypeScript.
highlights: Developed front-end web applications using TypeScript on the Angular framework.
Implemented REST API integration, connecting business logic to the Angular front-end.
Resolved partner-raised tickets and bugs related to the internal library and company framework in GitLab.
Verified API deployment status using Swagger and Postman.

workExperience.summary: Internship covering web development and technical documentation.
highlights: Contributed to web development using React and TypeScript.
Produced e-commerce technical documentation involving Next.js and AWS Lambda.
